# pcd_networking_port (Data Source)

Look up a Neutron port by ID or filters. Exactly one port must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-network"
}

data "pcd_networking_port" "example" {
  name       = "tf-example-port"
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Filter by (and report) the administrative state.
- `device_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the device ID.
- `device_owner` (String) Filter by (and report) the device owner.
- `mac_address` (String) Filter by (and report) the MAC address.
- `name` (String) Filter by (and report) the name.
- `network_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the network.
- `port_id` (String) Look up by port ID (takes precedence over filters).
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `status` (String) Filter by (and report) the operational status.
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the owning project.

### Read-Only

- `all_fixed_ips` (List of String) The IP addresses assigned to the port.
- `description` (String) The port description.
- `id` (String) The port ID.
- `security_group_ids` (Set of String) Security groups applied to the port.
